slides.title: Limgrave
slides.text: Green hills under the shadow of the Erdtree. The first place the Tarnished sees, and the gentlest. Do not let that fool you.

slides.title: Liurnia of the Lakes
slides.text: Flooded ruins, drifting mist and the sorcerers of the Academy. A land of quiet water and sharp glintstone.

slides.title: Caelid
slides.text: A battlefield turned wasteland. The crimson sky hangs over rot-eaten ground, and everything here wants you gone.

slides.title: Altus Plateau
slides.text: Golden fields, crystal cliffs and the road that leads to Leyndell, the Royal Capital.

slides.title: Mountaintops of the Giants
slides.text: A frozen peak at the edge of the world, where the Fire Giant keeps his old watch over the Forge of the Giants.

expansions.title: Elden Ring
expansions.text: The open world of the Lands Between, from Limgrave to the Elden Throne. Over a hundred hours of bosses, dungeons and secrets.

expansions.title: Shadow of the Erdtree
expansions.text: A new realm behind the Mohgwyn Palace: the Land of Shadow, with new weapons, spells, bosses and a long hidden story.

expansions.title: Elden Ring Nightreign
expansions.text: A separate co-op action game set in the same world. Short expeditions, a closing night, and a boss at the end of each run.
